algorithm: {The proposed algorithm uses a combination of random search and greedy descent to explore the search space efficiently, exploiting the fact that we are dealing with a simple global optimization problem.}

{This algorithm is a simple implementation of a (1+λ)-ES with restarts: it iteratively generates new candidate solutions using a normal distribution centered at the current best solution and then selects the best solution between the current best and all newly generated candidates, repeating this process until the budget is depleted.}
